mapper.select: select subject_id as subjectId, subject_code as subjectCode, subject_name as subjectName, subject_type as subjectType, balance_direction as balanceDirection, status, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_by as updateBy, update_time as updateTime, remark from fin_account_subject where subject_id = #{subjectId}
mapper.update: update fin_auxiliary_item set item_code = #{itemCode}, item_name = #{itemName}, status = coalesce(#{status}, '0'), update_by = coalesce(#{operator}, 'admin'), update_time = sysdate() where auxiliary_type = #{auxiliaryType} and relation_id = #{relationId}
mapper.select: select customer_id as relationId, customer_code as itemCode, customer_name as itemName, status from md_customer where coalesce(del_flag, '0') = '0'
select supplier_id as relationId, supplier_code as itemCode, supplier_name as itemName, status from md_supplier where coalesce(del_flag, '0') = '0'
select warehouse_id as relationId, warehouse_code as itemCode, warehouse_name as itemName, status from md_warehouse where coalesce(del_flag, '0') = '0'

select period_id as periodId, period_code as periodCode, start_date as startDate, end_date as endDate, close_status as closeStatus, close_by as closeBy, close_time as closeTime from fin_fiscal_period where period_id = #{periodId}
select count(1) from fin_fiscal_period where period_code = #{periodCode}
select period_code from fin_fiscal_period where close_status = 'closed' and date(#{targetDate}) between start_date and end_date limit 1
select count(1) from fin_fiscal_period where period_code < #{periodCode} and close_status != 'closed'
select count(1) from fin_fiscal_period where period_code > #{periodCode} and close_status = 'closed'
mapper.update: update fin_fiscal_period set close_status = #{closeStatus}, close_by = case when #{closeStatus} = 'closed' then #{operator} else null end, close_time = case when #{closeStatus} = 'closed' then sysdate() else null end, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = sysdate() where period_id = #{periodId}
